units.source_text: 三公主的伺候人中，有一个地位甚高的乳母。

en.t: Among the attendants of the Third Princess, there was a wet nurse of very high standing.

units.source_text: 这乳母的哥哥是个左中弁，常常出入于六条院源氏之家，

en.t: This wet nurse's elder brother was a Sachuben, and he often came and went from Genji's residence at Rokujo-in,

units.source_text: 在他家伺候已有多年。

en.t: having served in his household for many years.

units.source_text: 同时他又特别忠诚地为三公主服务。

en.t: At the same time, he also served the Third Princess with particular loyalty.

units.source_text: 有一天，这左中弁来三公主院中，与他的妹妹乳母相见。

en.t: One day, this Sachuben came to the Third Princess's residence and met with his younger sister, the wet nurse.

units.source_text: 在谈话中，乳母对他说道：“朱雀上皇有如此这般的打算，曾经向我示意。

en.t: During their conversation, the wet nurse said to him, "The Retired Emperor Suzaku has such and such intentions, and he once hinted them to me.

units.source_text: 有机会时，请你将此意告知你家六条院主人。

en.t: When you have the opportunity, please convey this meaning to your master at Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 公主不嫁，乃古来通例。

en.t: It has long been customary for princesses not to marry.

units.source_text: 但倘有夫婿对她多方爱护，照顾一切，则更可放心。

en.t: But if she had a husband who cared for her in every way and looked after everything, we could feel far more at ease.

units.source_text: 我家公主除了朱雀上皇以外，别无真心爱护她的人。

en.t: Our princess has no one who truly loves and protects her apart from the Retired Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 我不过在这里伺候而已，有什么用处呢？

en.t: I merely serve here; what use can I really be?

units.source_text: 况且伺候人甚多，不是万事可由我一人做主的。

en.t: Besides, there are many attendants, and not everything can be decided by me alone.

units.source_text: 因此难免发生意外之事，赢得轻薄之名，那时叫我何等伤心！

en.t: For that reason, some unexpected mishap may well occur and bring her a frivolous reputation; how heartbroken I would be then!

units.source_text: 所以，倘能于朱雀上皇在世之时，决定了公主的终身，我这伺候人也可安心了。

en.t: So if the princess's future could be settled while the Retired Emperor Suzaku is still alive, even I, her attendant, could be at peace.

units.source_text: 大凡女子，无论血统何等尊贵，宿命如何不得而知，真乃可悲之事。

en.t: In general, no matter how noble a woman's bloodline may be, no one can know what fate awaits her; it is truly a sorrowful thing.

units.source_text: 在许多公主之中，上皇特别疼爱这位三公主。

en.t: Among his many princesses, the retired emperor especially cherishes this Third Princess.

units.source_text: 但也有人嫉妒她。

en.t: But there are also people who envy her.

units.source_text: 所以必须从长计议，使她不受一点诽谤才好。”

en.t: Therefore we must plan carefully over the long term, so that she suffers not the slightest slander."

units.source_text: 左中弁答道：“说也奇怪，六条院主人多情得厉害呢！

en.t: The Sachuben replied, "Strange as it may sound, the lord of Rokujo-in is terribly amorous.

units.source_text: 凡是一度钟情的女人，不论是他所心爱的，或者并无深情的，

en.t: Any woman to whom he has once given his heart, whether she is someone he deeply loves or someone for whom he has no great feeling,

units.source_text: 都迎接过来，教许多女人集中在自邸内。

en.t: he brings into his household, gathering many women within his own residence.

units.source_text: 然而他所重视的也有限制，恐怕只有紫夫人一人。

en.t: Yet there is a limit to whom he truly values; perhaps Lady Murasaki alone holds that place.

units.source_text: 因此之故，屈居在这一人的威势之下度送孤寂生涯的人，亦复不少。

en.t: For that reason, quite a few women live lonely lives, forced to remain beneath the authority of that one lady.

units.source_text: 然而三公主倘有宿世因缘，果如你所说的嫁到了六条院，

en.t: However, if the Third Princess has a bond from a former life and, just as you say, marries into Rokujo-in,

units.source_text: 那么据我推量，紫夫人即使威势盛大，也不能和她分庭抗礼。

en.t: then in my estimation, even Lady Murasaki, for all her great influence, could not stand as her equal.

units.source_text: 然而究竟如何，还得有所顾虑。

en.t: Still, as for how things would actually turn out, there would remain much to consider.

units.source_text: 这且不说。

en.t: But let us set that aside for now.

units.source_text: 主人常常私下对我讲心里的话，他说：‘我所享受的荣华富贵，在这末世已属过分，

en.t: My master often speaks privately to me of what is in his heart, saying, 'The glory and wealth I enjoy are already excessive for this latter age,

units.source_text: 我身可谓绝无遗憾了。

en.t: and as for myself, I can say I have no regrets at all.

units.source_text: 只是为了妇人之事，外则受人讥议，内则我心犹有不足之感。’的确如此，

en.t: Only in matters concerning women am I criticized by others outwardly, while inwardly I still feel something lacking.' It is indeed so,

units.source_text: 在我们看来也有这等感想。

en.t: and from our point of view as well, one has that same impression.

units.source_text: 因为由于种种因缘而受他荫庇的许多妇人，虽然不是身份低微、不堪匹配的人，

en.t: For the many ladies who, through various ties, live under his protection are not women of low status or unsuitable match,

units.source_text: 但都是普通人臣之女，没有与他地位相称的夫人。

en.t: but they are all daughters of ordinary courtiers, and there is no lady among them whose rank truly matches his own.

units.source_text: 所以三公主既欲下嫁，若能如你所说，嫁到六条院去，

en.t: Therefore, since the Third Princess is to marry down, if she could, as you say, marry into Rokujo-in,

units.source_text: 真是多么如意称心的好姻缘啊！”

en.t: what a perfectly satisfying and fortunate marriage it would be!"
